project.name: fido2-vault-broker
project.description: Linux daemon that mirrors a Bitwarden-API vault (Vaultwarden) into a TPM2-sealed local cache and exposes the cached passkeys as a virtual FIDO2/CTAP2 USB device via /dev/uhid. Per-machine, browser-agnostic; replaces the need for a per-browser Bitwarden extension when the only thing you actually need from the extension is WebAuthn signing.

build.cargo_features_comment: Cargo features enabled by `build.sh build`. The daemon path (uhid + ctap2 + bw_api integration) is gated behind `fido2`. Drop this list to a subset to build a no-uhid version that still has seal/unseal subcommands.

vault.default_endpoint_comment: operator MUST set in ~/.config/fido2-vault-broker/config.toml — no default in public repo
vault.comment: Endpoint and account identifier are read at runtime from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/fido2-vault-broker/config.toml. Vault password is unsealed from TPM2 at daemon start (PCR-bound).

ctap2.aaguid_comment: Each authenticator instance gets a stable AAGUID derived from machine-id + vault account identifier, so passkeys registered on this host are reproducible across reinstalls of the same TPM-bound machine.
